{{Quote|With both Rhosk and Hss'kas gone Warden Tosk is sure to know something is up. Now is our chance to finish it. Lord Cyssc sits secure in his Citadel, but there will be a way to rouse him. To call for aid would be a sign of weakness for Tosk, one he will not show. But Cyssc would be most pleased to answer such a call.|Gursan Bryes|<ref name="ROTW" />}}
'''Rhosk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] and Adjudant of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cyssc Blackscale]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Kymayrr]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating Adjudant Rhosk and capturing him. To that end, the spacer located his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] and disabled it. The damaged shuttle was then escorted back to the [[Kashyyyk Space Station]] so that Rhosk could be brought into custody.<ref name="ROTW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rhosk appeared aboard his shuttle in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
